# Copilot Instructions

- Never print, log, or echo secrets or URLs containing tokens.
- Read configuration only from environment variables.
- Never open or read `.env` files.
- Refactors must preserve behavior unless the task says otherwise.
- Ask before adding dependencies.
- Write small, typed functions with plain-English docstrings.
- Keep one concern per pull request.
- Ask before deleting files.
- Prefer the Python standard library.
